records.quote: Figure 23 depicts the calculated enthalpy of formation of the Mn-Tm intermetallic compounds at 298 K in comparison with Kim et al.'s assessment[19] and the DFT results.[93,94] The calculated enthalpies of formation of Mn12Tm, Mn23Tm6, and Mn2Tm are -1.384, -3.310, and -3.10 kJ/ mol-atom, respectively, which are less negative than those from Kim et al.,[19] but closer to the average values of the DFT data.[93,94]
